query: SELECT segments.message, segments.ordinal, segments.body FROM segments JOIN messages ON messages.uuid = segments.message WHERE messages.author = ?1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM span_edges WHERE span_edges.message = segments.message AND span_edges.ordinal = segments.ordinal) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM senses WHERE senses.message = segments.message AND senses.ordinal = segments.ordinal) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversational WHERE conversational.message = segments.message AND conversational.ordinal = segments.ordinal) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM segment_links WHERE (segment_links.source_message = segments.message AND segment_links.source_ordinal = segments.ordinal) OR (segment_links.target_message = segments.message AND segment_links.target_ordinal = segments.ordinal)) ORDER BY messages.at, segments.message, segments.ordinal
